items.title: [DroidKnights 2026] Workflow AX: From Auto-Documented Policies to E2E Testing
items.summary: Slides from DroidKnights 2026 (Nov 2, 2026) by Raemin Kang & Dayeon Baek, Yeogi Eottae. (Slides in Korean)How our Android team made AI coding agents work the team's way — from start to finish, with proof.1. Harness — a frame that keeps the AI on the team's workflow until the job is done- v1: shared team skill, Stop hook, test-gated Phase/Step- v2: per-repo config picks the checks; scripts, not the AI, decide pass/fail2. LLM Wiki — recording team decisions that never make it into code, so the AI reads them before it works3. Verification — not trusting "Done!" from the AI- Convention: andcon (Konsist, detekt, ktlint)- UI: Roborazzi + Figma value matching- Behavior: Maestro E2E—DroidKnights 2026 발표 자료입니다. AI 코딩 에이전트를 안드로이드 개발에 도입하며 하네스, LLM Wiki, 검증 도구로 문제를 푼 과정을 공유합니다.
